module: Carry out and maintain the assessment

lesson.title: Reassess changes to the system
lesson.summary: Evaluate changes rather than assuming every update is covered.

prerequisites.reason: The change test compares the current system and purpose with the initially assessed version.
The exception needs changes recorded in the initial technical documentation.

blocks: A **substantial modification** is a post-market/service change not foreseen or planned in the initial conformity assessment that affects compliance with Chapter III Section 2, or modifies the assessed intended purpose. Article 43(4) requires a new assessment even if the same deployer continues using the modified system without onward distribution.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Articles 3(23), 25, 43(4); Annex IV(2)(f); Annex VII(4.7)

blocks: Article 25 can make a distributor, importer, deployer or other third party the provider when the specified change conditions apply, including substantial modification of a system remaining high-risk or changing a previously non-high-risk system's purpose so it becomes high-risk. Record the actor and duties; do not assume the original provider is accountable for every later third-party change.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Articles 3(23), 25, 43(4); Annex IV(2)(f); Annex VII(4.7)

blocks: A **predetermined learning change** is a change and performance variation established by the provider at initial assessment and included in Annex IV(2)(f) documentation for a system continuing to learn. Article 43(4) says those specified changes are not substantial modifications. This is a bounded documented exception, not permission for any later model replacement.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Articles 3(23), 25, 43(4); Annex IV(2)(f); Annex VII(4.7)

blocks: For an Annex VII certificate, notify intended or discovered changes that could affect compliance or purpose. The body decides whether a new assessment is required or an assessed supplement is sufficient. Northbridge changing from an advisory summary to materially ranking applicants is a purpose/compliance review; maintaining a product name does not settle it.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Articles 3(23), 25, 43(4); Annex IV(2)(f); Annex VII(4.7)

questions.prompt: An unplanned compliance-affecting modification stays with the same deployer. Is distribution required for reassessment?

options.blocks: No; substantial modification can require a new assessment anyway.
options.reason: The paragraph explicitly includes continued use by the current deployer.

options.blocks: Yes; only a new sale triggers reassessment.
options.reason: The rule is not limited to onward distribution.
